behavior_constraints: && evaluates left operand first; if falsy, right operand is not evaluated and result is the left (falsy) value
|| evaluates left operand first; if truthy, right operand is not evaluated and result is the left (truthy) value
Side effects (function calls, prints, indexing) in the unevaluated operand of && or || do not occur
fn appearing in expression position produces a closure value
fn followed by a name at statement position continues to define a named function as before
Closures capture variables from enclosing scope by value at creation time
Mutations to captured non-array variables in outer scope after closure creation do not affect the closure's copy
Mutations to captured non-array variables inside the closure do not affect the outer scope
Multiple closures created in the same scope each get independent copies of captured values
Closures are callable via name(args) syntax identical to named function calls
